items.headline: FAA lifts ground stop after four hours, but flight cancellations will stretch into the weekend
items.summary: The Federal Aviation Administration issued a nationwide ground stop on Friday afternoon, disrupting thousands of departing of flights.

items.headline: Trump doesn’t plan to raise Nvidia, spy issue during China trip: U.S. officials
items.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned this week after reports of multiple affairs, including one with a suspected Chinese spy, Alice Huang.

items.headline: SpaceX launches Starship in key test flight of massive rocket
items.summary: The test flight is SpaceX's first attempt to ​catch both the Super Heavy booster and upper stage spacecraft of the rocket at its launch site in Starbase, Texas.

items.headline: Broadcom: Nvidia Has A Problem, And That Creates An Opportunity
items.summary: Analyst rates Broadcom Inc. a Buy: 68% semiconductor growth and an 18x FY2027 P/E support AI upside, with a potential single-digit P/E around 2029.

items.headline: US stocks fall as Nvidia slides 4.3%; Nasdaq drops 1.74%
items.summary: US stocks slide as Nvidia plunges 4.3%, dragging chipmakers lower. Nasdaq falls 1.74% as AI trade concerns and persistent inflation weigh on sentiment.

items.headline: Nvidia is done with Jensen Huang. The fallout in Washington is just beginning
items.summary: The Republican-led Congress wants to see Jensen Huang in Washington before Democrats take control in January.

items.headline: Lutnick faces questions over Nvidia spy scandal. His sons' firm has deep ties to the chipmaker
items.summary: Jensen Huang’s resignation as Nvidia CEO has brought renewed scrutiny to Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick and his family's financial ties to the chipmaker.

items.headline: US Stock Market today: S&P 500, Nasdaq fall ahead of Nvidia earnings report, Anthropic IPO. List of Wall Street stocks that rise on Friday
items.summary: S&P 500, Nasdaq's losses came ahead of AI company Anthropic's much-anticipated IPO next week. Nvidia is scheduled to announce earnings report on next Tuesday, November 17.

items.headline: Nvidia stock suffers longest weekly losing streak since 2012 as market value sinks by $1.7 trillion
items.summary: Jensen Huang's resignation added to Nvidia's market woes, with the stock already in a downward slide since early October.

items.headline: Hackers stole $6.3 billion from Binance—2 habits that take 'a few seconds' can help you avoid similar traps
items.summary: Researchers from the Digital Inquiry Group say that two habits that take just "a few seconds up front" can help keep you from being "duped" online.

items.headline: Goldman Sachs looks to cash in on big IPOs twice. Anthropic’s historic deal is its next chance
items.summary: While co-leading the offering, Goldman also wants a shot at managing the billions of dollars in new wealth that the deal creates. It's not the only one.

items.headline: What's ahead for AI financing after Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang departs
items.summary: Jensen Huang’s resignation puts Nvidia’s AI financing strategy in focus as investors watch credit markets and neocloud exposure.

items.headline: AI risks are the biggest threat to the financial system, Fed survey finds
items.summary: The report comes with Wall Street on edge over high-flying AI hyperscalers, while communities are on alert for the rapid spread of data centers.

items.headline: They train people to avoid 'honeypot' scams—here are the common red flags they spot: 'It feels so good to be wanted'
items.summary: Corporate security firms train companies and their employees on strategies for being vigilant against honeypots, and other social engineering attacks.

items.headline: Supreme Court agrees to hear Robinhood challenge to IPO information omission lawsuit
items.summary: The Trump administration had urged the Supreme Court to hear an appeal by Robinhood of a lower-court's decision to revive an investors' lawsuit over the IPO.

items.headline: Hassett denies report he's leaving White House: 'Not true'
items.summary: National Economic Council Director Kevin Hassett poured cold water on a report that he's expected to leave the White House in the coming weeks.

items.headline: After Jensen Huang’s exit, what top financial advisors are doing with Nvidia: Exclusive CNBC poll
items.summary: Advisors say investors should weigh their Nvidia exposure, time horizon and risk tolerance before reacting to the leadership change.

items.headline: A trading strategy to ride out the Nvidia uncertainty and generate income in the process
items.summary: By deploying a persistent covered call strategy, investors can leverage the exact fear driving the stock down to generate robust, risk-reducing income.

items.headline: Retirees sometimes tap savings for one-off expenses. Here’s what advisors say to consider first
items.summary: Retirees who need cash for a one-time expense may look to their 401(k) or IRA, but financial advisors say there are trade-offs to weigh first.

items.headline: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Wallet, allowing its 'dots' AI agents to make purchases for users
items.summary: OpenAI's ChatGPT Wallet partners with American Express, Mastercard and Visa, and those cardholders keep their existing credit card rewards.
